lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 9.2 million buildings with an average data age of 3 years and 4% updated within the last 6 months, providing a spatial inventory of building structures for exposure assessment.
